objective: Fix Godot 4.7.2 exported PCK world test failing due to raw WebP/WAV load paths not preserved in packed/imported resources; compile true three-world visuals/audio and keep offline practice boundaries.
productionBaselineEvidence: Headless DEV Godot export run 45142483035 produced a real 34,970,196-byte GDPC PCK and passed Arena startup plus Arena smoke, but world_smoke failed with res://world-art/kingdom.webp and res://world-audio/navigation.wav missing after export. Main remains source SHA 7b224c39624827282c3cbf003060317045b0a73f; no production runtime verification.
chosenApproach: Replace file-system Image.load_from_file/AudioStreamWAV.load_from_file with static imported-resource preloads to guarantee PCK inclusion; update world smoke test to assert real Texture2D/AudioStream in PCK, not just source file existence. Re-run exact bounded GitHub world pack job, no APK.
selectionRationale: The PCK exported successfully and worked for Arena; exported Godot resource importer does not preserve raw WebP/WAV paths. Using preload() is the canonical imported resource approach and ensures references are included. Do not bypass smoke error parsing or pad binaries.
